<STBG 2,0><TALK 1><NAME 1><BGM 0,0,503><CHAR 1,1,1,0,8><CV 1,18>Huh!?
A Poogie in a place like this...

There there there...
Whose child is this...

Right, there are monsters, it's dangerous!
Anyway, we'd better protect it.

My leg is stuck...
It just won't come out...

<TALK 1><CHAR 1,0,1,1,7><CV 1,39>Ouch ouch ouch...
What do we do...
Pulling won't get it out!

If we dig around here we might manage!
Something strong against mud...

<CHAR 1,0,1,0,8>That's it!
With <COL C70101FF>Gobul Fang</COL>
we could use it as a shovel!

<COL C70101FF>Gobul Fang</COL> can be gathered
from <COL C70101FF>Gobul</COL>!
